name: Cocoon
source:
Later half of 21st century, summer. Tokyo after the Great Earthquake.
The world where the chosen few are embedded with a microchip named "Sky Implant"(AKA: Si) and are controlled by the system.
Hajima Sora had been given the skill set of an "Artist".
After graduating from a special training school, lived like a hermit in a Si-based mansion "Cocoon".
All jobs were conducted over the internet, daily necessaries were bought on-line and days goes by without having any human contact.
One day, an incident occurs that shatters the secluded freedom he so enjoyed...
translation:
21世纪后半叶，夏季。大地震后的东京。
在这个世界中，少数被选中的人被嵌入名为“Sky Implant”（又名：Si）的微芯片并由系统控制。
元岛空被赋予了“艺术家”的技能。
从特训学校毕业后，在Si基地宅邸“Cocoon”中过着隐士般的生活。
所有工作都通过网络进行，生活必需品都在网上购买，日子一天天过去，没有任何人的接触。
有一天，发生了一件事情，打破了他如此享受的与世隔绝的自由……
